signatures.description: Implement a B+tree key codec with shared prefix compression plus suffix truncation, where every internal separator is stored as the shortest key satisfying last_key(left) < separator <= first_key(right), with a page-level prefix length and a per-key truncation length. Your split path must derive a legal minimal separator (including the all-equal-prefix case, which needs an appended sentinel byte and must stay strictly above the left page's last key), then repair sibling pointers and the rightmost-page flag when the split target is the rightmost leaf or the root. Add decode-side validation that rejects pages whose reconstructed ordering violates the truncated-separator invariant, and a fuzz harness that diffs the compressed tree against an uncompressed reference tree across 100k randomized insert/delete/point-lookup/range-scan operations.
